prompt:
Build a closed-loop automatic syringe infusion pump using Simulink, Stateflow, and Simscape. The physical delivery path must include an electrically driven motor, a mechanical transmission that moves a syringe plunger, a fluid reservoir and compliant delivery line, and a patient-side pressure boundary. The same physical plant that produces the measured flow and pressure must close the motor-speed and safety feedback loops; independent prescribed flow or prerecorded output trajectories are not sufficient.

Read delivery_mode, bolus_magnitude_units, bolus_stroke_time_s, pause_time_s, cycle_count, quick_bolus_magnitude_units, quick_bolus_stroke_time_s, basal_rate_units_per_hour, patient_backpressure_Pa, occlusion_onset_s, occlusion_fraction, and low_remaining_limit_units from the MATLAB base workspace. delivery_mode is 1 for a repeated normal bolus, 2 for a repeated four-stroke quick-bolus profile, and 3 for basal delivery. Support the ranges, vector shapes, and coupled magnitude-to-stroke-rate limits declared in the task metadata.

delivery_mode is one of 1 (normal bolus), 2 (quick bolus), or 3 (basal delivery); bolus_magnitude_units is in [0.5, 1.0] unit with bolus_magnitude_units/bolus_stroke_time_s <= 1.0 unit/s; bolus_stroke_time_s is in [1, 3] s; pause_time_s is in [3, 10] s; cycle_count is in [1, 20]; quick_bolus_magnitude_units is a 4-element vector with each value in [0.5, 1.0] unit and quick_bolus_stroke_time_s is a 4-element vector with each value in [1, 3] s, with each corresponding magnitude/stroke-time ratio <= 1.0 unit/s; basal_rate_units_per_hour is in [0.5, 2.0] unit/h; patient_backpressure_Pa is in [90000, 160000] Pa; occlusion_onset_s is in [25, 70] s; occlusion_fraction is in [0, 0.9999] (unitless); and low_remaining_limit_units is in [0, 100] unit.

Implement the three delivery modes with closed-loop motor-speed regulation and physically delivered dose. Dose must be generated by plunger motion through the hydraulic path. Detect and report a delivery-line occlusion from plant feedback, produce a physical reduction in patient-side flow under a severe occlusion, and avoid false alarms for valid non-occluding pressure loads. Delivery must also be supervised using the physically estimated remaining amount and the configured safety limit. The internal controller, state representation, and detection method are not prescribed.

Log complete-run Timeseries named motion_state, delivery_state, and safety_state. motion_state has four channels [reference motor speed in RPM, measured motor speed in RPM, motor voltage in V, piston displacement in mm]. delivery_state has four channels [upstream flow in mm^3/min, patient-side flow in mm^3/min, line pressure in Pa, cumulative delivered amount in units]. safety_state has four channels [load force in N, occlusion alarm, delivery enabled, remaining amount in units]. These logs must be produced causally by one simulation and must not be copies of workspace inputs or precomputed trajectories.

Save the completed model as cand_XMED07.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMED07.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
